body:
Test-only fix: https://github.com/patrick-hudson/put.gd-desktop/pull/1203, head `d25cbc8e837fe96733926a65de54b6b93dbeff45`.

The test races the child's first marker against Qt's process-start notification. `QProcess::start()` returns in `Starting`. If the child has already written `starts` when `PUTGD_TRY_COMPARE(lines().size(),1)` first checks, that helper succeeds without processing events. The synchronous `waitForFinished()` on the *second* process does not establish the first process's Qt state. The first process can therefore still be observed as `Starting`, even though the OS child is running and correctly left untouched.

The test-only change calls `other.waitForStarted(putgd::test::scaled(5000))` before the marker check and before invoking the restart script. The original final `Running` assertion and single-marker assertion remain unchanged, so a restart script that kills or duplicates the other-session process still fails.

**Before: 2/20 failed. After: 0/20 failed.** Both baseline failures were the reported `other.state(): Starting` versus `Running` assertion at original line 263. Every original process/script assertion remains in place.

Measured on k72 (Kubuntu/Ubuntu 26.04.1, Qt 6.10.2, GCC 15.2), `tools/ci/stress_suite.py`, no retries: 20 iterations, four busy loops on CPUs 0–1, tests on CPUs 0–1, `PUTGD_TEST_TIME_SCALE=3`, two CTest tests in parallel. Each iteration ran the full `file_manager_integration` suite plus all data rows of `scrollingPaintsOnlyWhatScrollsIn`, `manyActiveOperationsKeepOneBannerLine`, and `failedUploadSavesDiagnosticsForThatOperation` through a saved focused CTest manifest. The before source was `31c502cbb742679dca301c08293bc1c8a6b62c4e`; after used the two independently built test replacements. Core/app/UI library and `putgd-ui` SHA-256 values were unchanged.

Raw ledgers, JUnit, source snapshots, commands, socket preflight and exact identities: `/home/patrick/work/putgd-evidence/2026-11-04-stable-prep/flakes/`; builder `~/work/flake-stress/1104-flakes-{before,after}`. The interrupted d69 overlap attempt completed no iterations and is excluded. These are SSH/offscreen test contracts, not desktop acceptance.

Additional full-suite stress: `file_manager_integration`, `gui_history_view`, and `gui_history_view_text150` all passed in one iteration with the same four-hog/CPU-0–1/scale-3 contention (parallel 3); total 146.66 seconds. No assertion remains failing in the measured after runs.

PR remains a draft to honor the coordination rule not to trigger automatic CodeRabbit review. PR #1203: required **CI succeeded**, both Linux jobs and contracts succeeded, no reviews. The sanitizer job also succeeded.

Reopened: the test passed only on its retry again.
